data.body: ESCALATION — design fork, not proceeding without a recorded decision. This ticket's recorded scope is ambiguous between two mutually exclusive options: (1) add a synthetic-tree test registering a prefixed KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS row and asserting both scanners (gen_env_registry._scan_call and check_config_ownership._helper_access) apply the prefix — cheap, keeps the feature honest; or (2) remove the prefix field from both consumers, simplifying both tables to a bare int — which the ticket itself flags as 'a behaviour-narrowing change and needs its own review'. The AC is written as 'Either … or …', so neither option is the recorded decision. Analysis toward that decision: all 9 live rows declare an empty prefix; the only historical user (_rebar_env with REBAR_) was drained by the RP-04 cutover d361eb28e4; the prefix APPLICATION code is still live in both scanners (grep confirms 'prefix + lit' at gen_env_registry.py _scan_call and check_config_ownership.py _helper_access), so this is an unused-but-wired feature, not dead code — deletion would narrow behaviour, and covering it would preserve optionality at the cost of testing an unused feature. A human/owner should pick option 1 or 2 and record it here (or split option 2 into its own reviewed ticket per the ticket's own note); then implementation is mechanical either way. No code touched under this ticket.
